findings.statement: C direction is not load-bearing in the bounded common scalar carrier. The coarsest realized C partition is the three-class active-sign-support cardinality {0,1,2}, represented equivalently by TOTAL, ABS_NET, or UNORDERED_PAIR.
Directional information is not anchored to D or A individually. Exact Pareto classes exist with D direction discarded and A directional, and with A direction discarded and D directional.
Every common-exact RS-077 candidate retains an orientation-sensitive coupling, SIGNED_NET or SEPARATED, in at least one of D or A. No common-exact candidate discards direction in both families.

After mechanically quotienting mode aliases by their realized family partitions, the common Pareto frontier has four classes: D TOTAL/A SIGNED_NET; D SIGNED_NET/A TOTAL-or-UNORDERED; D ABS_NET/A SEPARATED; D SEPARATED/A ABS_NET.

The verifier reports fifteen Pareto-minimal mode-label points, but they collapse outcome-independently to four partition-equivalence classes because C has a three-way mode alias and A has TOTAL=UNORDERED_PAIR.
6x3-k3 accepts all 125 coupling candidates, 4x5-k4 accepts 80, and horizontal-only 6x3-k4 accepts exactly the 65 common-exact candidates; 6x3-k4 therefore determines the present transfer set.
All four Pareto equivalence classes preserve scalar image dimensions 1,2,2. Their representatives reduce 6x3-k4 structural rank from 14 to 13 and can reduce 4x5-k4 rank from 252 to 250.
TOTAL, SIGNED_NET, and ABS_NET act on the exact sets represented by saturated source categories. Replacing 1+,2+,3+ by their lower-bound numerals is not a valid quotient of EW-RS-076.
RS-077 information containment is now derived exhaustively from the frozen finite source alphabets and coupling maps; no scalar outcome is used to define or repair the Pareto order.

nextQuestion: Can an outcome-independent joint D/A circuit or finite relation factor all four frozen Pareto equivalence classes to a common native carrier while preserving the scalar image?
